searches: site:arpconferences.org Quest Horizon conference Appalachia Mission work crew

extraction.notes: The provider has posted its 2027 offerings. None qualify under the directory's camp rule: Quest and Horizon are explicitly youth conferences, Appalachia Mission is a mission trip, and Family Bible Conference is a family conference. Existing program names were retained in the exclusions. The attempted Work Crew and Family Bible Conference pages returned no readable text; Family Bible Conference is identified as a conference on the supplied homepage and the official About page.

excluded.name: Quest
excluded.reason: An annual middle-school youth conference, excluded under the conference rule. Students lodge and participate with their church groups; the provider explicitly states that no camp counselors are provided.

excluded.name: Horizon
excluded.reason: An annual high-school youth conference, excluded under the conference rule. Students lodge and participate with their church groups; the provider explicitly states that no camp counselors are provided.

excluded.name: Appalachia Mission
excluded.reason: A mission trip in which youth groups and adults lead Vacation Bible Schools in Kentucky, Tennessee, and Virginia; mission trips are excluded. Its gathering site is Camp Jubilee in Tazewell, TN, outside the directory's area.

excluded.name: Family Bible Conference
excluded.reason: A family conference, excluded under the conference rule rather than a separately identified supervised youth summer camp.
